name: Das Liebener
beschreibung:
Enjoying a sunny hillside location with panoramic views over the Oetztal Alps, Das Liebener welcomes guests in Soelden. The stylishly furnished apartments offer expansive living space and private balconies for quiet relaxation.

The base stations of the Giggijoch and Gaislachkogl gondolas are quickly accessible, making it an excellent base for skiers, hikers, and mountain bikers alike.
kurzbeschreibung: Das Liebener in Soelden provides contemporary apartments in a quiet panoramic setting close to the Oetztal cable cars.
